title: People’s Mañanera November 17
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Sheinbaum Presents Plan Mexico and the Results of the 4T at APEC  
** Speaking before business leaders, President Claudia Sheinbaum highlighted
poverty reduction and investment opportunities in highways, energy, ports, and
tourism as part of the strategy to drive the country’s development.

**Vaccination Reduces Measles Cases by More Than 90%  
** With 41 million doses administered and nearly 19,000 door-to-door visits,
there are 14 active cases remaining. 10.8 million free vaccines are available.
The goal is to end the outbreak by 2027 and regain certification as a measles-
free country by 2028.

**With Door-to-Door Visits, the Government Aims to Ensure No One Is Left Out
of School  
** Interior Minister Rosa Icela Rodríguez explained that social workers find
children or young people out of school, they return and talk with their
families until they get them back in the classroom. This is how the root
causes of violence are addressed.
